items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Piron was playing... Never seen one outside the Piron band. It was the first one... That tune also came out as a waltz... after we learned it, we'd pick it up and play it in double time.

ctx.x: Esther Bidoux(?) or Lilah(?) Bolden were the singers who recorded with Piron.
It well could have been, but it was a carnival night, and I had been drinking, and we stopped near the St. Catherine Hall, and Piron was playing. And
